s:

x: Justice Markandeya Katju apologised (January 2017) for his blog criticising the Supreme Court's 2016 verdict in the Soumya case – the rape and murder of a young woman on a train in Kerala – which had set aside the murder conviction. It was not about NJAC, Jallikattu or Kashmir.

src: Social Structure, Issues and Public Policies 2016
s: Nirbhaya Act is the popular name for the following Act.
x: The Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013, passed after the December 2012 Delhi gang rape, is popularly called the Nirbhaya Act; the other titles are not Indian Acts.

src: TSPSC Extension Officer Paper-II 2023
s: ____ fund has been set up by the Government of India to address the safety and security of women.
x: The Nirbhaya Fund (2013) is a non-lapsable corpus set up by the Government of India for schemes on the safety and security of women (OSCs, 181, 112, Safe City, FTSCs). Beti Bachao and Swadhar are schemes, not funds.

src: APPSC Junior Assistant cum Computer Assistant in ANGRAU Gene
s: The Nirbhaya Act, 2013 also defines more sexual offences besides rape. These are:
at: Both (Stalking and Voyeurism) and (Gang rape and Sexual harassment)
x: CLA 2013 added new offences besides widening rape: sexual harassment (354A), disrobing (354B), voyeurism (354C), stalking (354D), acid attack (326A/B) and a revised gang-rape section (376D).

src: APPSC Assistant B.C. Welfare Officer, Assistant Social Welfa
s: The Nirbhaya Act came into existence on
x:
Most books and keys: 3 April 2013. Strictly: assent 2 April 2013, deemed in force from 3 February 2013 (s.1(2) of the Act, latestlaws.com).
The Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013 got Presidential assent on 2 April 2013 and was notified the next day (3 April 2013, the date most books give); legally it is deemed in force from 3 February 2013, the date of the ordinance it replaced.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: In December 2019, ____ announced that it would be setting up 45 new fast-track courts to hear cases of sexual crimes against women and children in the state.
x: Odisha announced 45 new fast-track courts in December 2019 for sexual crimes against women and children (21 for rape, 24 for POCSO cases).

src: APPSC Group-2 PYQ
s: Which among the following IT initiatives by the Ministry of Home Affairs facilitates dissemination of information about significant crimes, including Human Trafficking across the country on real time basis and enables Interstate co-ordination?
o: Investigation Tracking System for Sexual Offences (ITSSO)
Special Police Unit for Women and Children (SPUWAC)
x: Cri-MAC (Crime Multi-Agency Centre, MHA) shares information on major crimes, including trafficking, in real time and coordinates between States. ITSSO only tracks the 2-month investigation deadline and NDSO is a police-only database of convicted sexual offenders.

src: APPSC Polytechnic Lecturers (S1) General Studies & Mental Ab
s: The Uttar Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation has started a helpline service ____ with women's safety in mind.
x: UPSRTC launched the 'Damini' (Daamini) calling and WhatsApp helpline for women passengers in December 2019 under the Nirbhaya scheme.

src: AP High Court Assistant Examiner-1 2021
s: Which section of the Indian Penal Code deals with Cheating and Dishonestly inducing delivery of property?
x:
the IPC was replaced by the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita from 1 July 2024 — now cheating with inducing delivery of property is Section 318(4) BNS (general knowledge, not checked)
Section 420 IPC punished cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property (now Section 318(4) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, in force from 1 July 2024). Sections 470, 455 and 320 dealt with forged documents, house-trespass and grievous hurt.

src: APPSC Assistant Social, B.C. & Tribal Welfare Officers Mains
s: Name of the victim of rape case cannot be published, without the permission of
x: Section 228A IPC (now Section 72 BNS) bars publishing a rape victim's name except by or under the written order of the officer in charge of the police station or the investigating police officer – the 'Inspector of police' option – or with the victim's (or her next of kin's) written authorisation to a recognised welfare organisation. The Government in general and religion play no role.

src: APPSC Group-I 2017
s: As per the 2016 report on Global Trafficking in Persons published by UN Office on Drugs & Crime, Victims and Traffickers often have
x: UNODC's Global Report on Trafficking in Persons 2016 found that traffickers and their victims often share the same ethnic background, language or place of origin, which builds trust and helps recruitment.
